Thanks for the ping Marissa. My thoughts: 

1) Demo format: Live SE demo with a short perf run is highest impact here - they care about latency. Proposed agenda (30-45 min):
   - 5m: Goals and current infra
   - 15m: Live perf demo with representative payloads (I can bring a 200req/s simulation)
   - 10m: Architecture and deployment options (dedicated vs hosted)
   - 10m: Q&A + next steps

2) Tech asks: Confirmed that sequence lengths ~512 - recommend 8xA10G or 4xH100 logical sizing for a POC depending on concurrency; we can present a small cost comparison.

3) Outreach language (suggested short email):
> Hi Evan - quick follow-up from our last chat. We’d love to run a short SE demo to show live latency and cost tradeoffs with a tailored perf run. Marcus is available next week; any time Tue/Wed works? We can also outline a short 6-week POC if that helps.

If we want to be more aggressive, I’m fine including a token credit offer (25k) but recommend we reserve that for leadership approval.

Happy to take lead on the demo and script.
